title: 90-Day Renewal Checkpoint — Facilitator Manual
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact facilitator manual for a 90-day Renewal Checkpoint meeting used with mid-market and strategic customers. It is optimized for a 60 minute cadence (stretch / fallback variants included) and is intentionally prescriptive so CSMs can run tight, outcomes-driven conversations that surface renewal signals and concrete next steps.

Audience:
- Primary: Customer Success Manager (facilitator), Account Executive (if renewal is at stake), Solutions Engineer (optional)
- Secondary: Customer stakeholders (Product Owner, Engineering Lead, Procurement champion)

Desired outcomes (explicit):
1) Alignment on health signals and renewal likelihood (green / yellow / red) with evidence attached.
2) Clear list of blockers and owners required to reach renewal decision milestone.
3) A documented next-step cadence (owners, due dates, escalation path).
4) If at-risk, an agreed remediation plan and decision checkpoints.

Meeting lengths & variants:
- Standard 60m (recommended for strategic / expansion customers)
  - 00:00–00:05 — Welcome & objectives (CSM)
  - 00:05–00:15 — Customer voice: progress & priorities since last checkpoint (customer)
  - 00:15–00:30 — Health signals deep-dive (CSM presents evidence: usage, latency, errors, ROI metrics)
  - 00:30–00:45 — Risks & blockers + remediation options (facilitated discussion)
  - 00:45–00:55 — Decision ledger + commitment capture (owners, dates)
  - 00:55–01:00 — Close & next meeting (CSM recap)

- Lightning 30m (renewal decision already likely; quick alignment)
  - 00:00–00:03 — Objectives & outcomes
  - 00:03–00:10 — Quick health snapshot (CSM)
  - 00:10–00:22 — Confirm remediation/next steps 
  - 00:22–00:30 — Close & commitments

Pre-meeting facilitator checklist (72–24 hours before):
- Data pull: token consumption trends, latency percentiles, error spikes, embedding usage (by project), billing anomalies, SLA incidents. Attach last 90d charts.
- Customer signals: recent support tickets, feature requests, executive comms, product launches impacting usage.
- Renewal status: contract end date, auto-renew terms, current TCV, any open legal or procurement items.
- Stakeholder map: confirm attendees + decision authority. Add an optional second-line approver for escalations.
- Pre-read: 1-page health snapshot + proposed agenda. Send at least 48 hours prior.
- Internal prep: sync w/ AE and SE; highlight any commercial asks or planned offers.

Facilitation script (concise prompts CSM can read aloud):
- Welcome (00:00–00:02): "Thanks all for making time. Goal for today: get to a single, evidence-backed renewal signal and a set of action owners to ensure we hit the decision milestone. If we need more time, we’ll document what to resolve and set a follow-up."

- Customer voice prompt (00:05–00:15): "Before I share the health snapshot, I’d love to hear what’s top of mind for you since our last check. What progress or roadblocks have materially changed your view of value?"

- Health deep-dive intro (00:15): "I’ll walk through three signal categories: adoption (usage trends), reliability (latency/errors), and outcomes (business impact). For each signal I’ll share the data and one interpretation — tell me what you see differently."

- Risk surfacing (00:30): "Let’s list the top 3 risks to renewal. For each risk: 1) brief description, 2) owner for remediation, 3) target completion date, 4) what success looks like."

- Decision ledger close (00:45): "We’ll capture decisions in the ledger now — for each action we need an owner and a due date. If the action impacts procurement/legal/engineering, we’ll flag it for escalation. Do we have alignment on the commitments?"

Decision ledger template (to paste in meeting notes):
- Decision / Action: [short text]
- Owner: [name]
- Due Date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Evidence required to close: [artifact or metric]
- Escalation lane (if missed): [name/email]

Renewal risk rubric (CSM quick scoring):
- Green: Clear usage growth, no open priority bugs, exec sponsor engaged. Renewal probability > 85%.
- Yellow: Mixed signals (flat usage, one critical bug mitigated, procurement flagged a question). Renewal probability 50–85% — needs remediation plan.
- Red: Declining usage, multiple unresolved reliability issues, procurement or legal objections. Renewal probability < 50% — requires escalation and commercial options.

Signals & evidence checklist (CSM fill during meeting):
- Product usage: 30/7 active users, top 3 projects by API tokens, policy on burst patterns
- Performance: p95 latency, error rate trends last 30 days, any post-deploy regressions
- Business outcomes: case studies, revenue-linked metrics, time-to-value anecdotes
- Support: number of P1/P2 incidents in 90d and mean time to resolution
- Commercial: open PO, budget window, procurement timeline

Triage scripts & escalation lanes:
- If score flips to RED during meeting: pause, capture immediate mitigation (owner + 48–72h triage), schedule engineering war room if reliability-related. Notify AE and solutions lead within 2 business hours.
- If procurement/legal blocking: capture exact ask, escalate to AE + Legal contact, propose interim commercial deferment or conditional extension as allowed by policy.

Post-meeting follow-up template (send within 24 hours):
Subject: Follow-up: 90-Day Renewal Checkpoint — [Account Name] — [Date]
Body bullets to include:
- One-sentence summary of renewal signal (Green/Yellow/Red) with 2 bullet evidence points
- Decision ledger (copied) with owners and due dates
- Immediate next steps and owner commits (include links to tickets or Confluence pages)
- Proposed next checkpoint date and purpose
- Request: confirmation from each owner that the dates are realistic

Quick renewal tracker fields (paste into account sheet as single row):
- account_name, contract_end_date, renewal_window_start, current_probability (G/Y/R), last_health_update (YYYY-MM-DD), last_usage_change_pct, open_blockers_count, AE_owner, CSM_owner, next_checkpoint_date

Sample closing prompt (CSM): "Thanks everyone — our commitments are captured. I’ll follow up with the notes and the action list within 24 hours. If you can confirm your assigned due dates in that thread, we’ll treat those as firm."

Facilitator tips & anti-patterns:
- Don’t present raw data without interpretation; highlight the one insight you want the room to act on.
- Avoid turning the meeting into a demo — demos belong in product syncs.
- If the customer starts drifting to roadmap design discussions, park it as a follow-up and capture owners.
- When a blocker is flagged as "engineering" but lacks a ticket, stop and create one live in the meeting (owner + ticket link).

Appendix: two short email snippets (copy-paste)
- Pre-read send (48h before): "Hi all — agenda + 1-page health snapshot attached. Goal: confirm renewal signal and next steps. Please review and surface any additional topics by EOD tomorrow."
- Post-meeting summary (24h after): "Thanks for the meeting. Summary below + decision ledger. Next checkpoint scheduled for [date]. Please reply to confirm your commitments."

Version history & notes:
- v0.1 (2025-08-12) initial draft
- v0.2 (2025-09-03) added decision ledger template and escalation lanes after CS sync

End of manual.
